title: Model Metrics Cardflow — compact per-route & per-model dashboard card and chart specs
creator: Elena Kim
description: Goal: Design a compact, reusable card (Cardflow) for the Redwood Console that surfaces per-model and per-route performance metrics (latency P50/P90, throughput RPS, token/sec, tokens/generated, error rate, and cost per 1k tokens). The card should be embeddable in model, route, and team dashboards and work responsively in list and detail contexts. Background: current performance canvas feels heavy for lists and comparison views. Teams need a scannable summary card for anomaly triage and quick rollouts decisions. This ticket contains visual specs, responsive behaviors, and chart choices (sparklines, stacked bars, micro histograms) plus accessibility considerations and a small prototype for usability testing.
scope: Design compact metric card for list & detail contexts
Define primary & secondary metric prioritization and display rules
Chart spec: sparkline latency with shading for P50/P90, throughput mini-bar, token throughput numeric + delta
Provide responsive layout for 3 breakpoints (desktop, tablet, mobile)
Export Figma prototype and handoff tokens to engineering
non_goals: New telemetry or ingestion work — assumes existing metrics in telemetry API
Billing engine changes — cost numbers are read-only from current cost service
acceptance_criteria: Card component design approved by PM and Eng and added to Console component library
Figma prototype linked and clickable for desktop/tablet/mobile
Chart specs provide rendering guidance (data shape, update frequency, fallback states)
Accessibility: color contrast and screen-reader label examples included
Engineering receives design tokens and a priority list of interactions for implementation
chart_specs: Latency sparkline: single-line area chart with P50 line (solid) and P90 band (shaded). Data points: timestamped p50, p90 values. Recommended downsample window: 1m for 24h range.
Throughput mini-bar: discrete bars per 1m bucket with hover tooltip showing RPS and request count. Default aggregation: sum(requests)/minute.
Token throughput: numeric KPI showing tokens/sec (rounded to 1 decimal) with 1h delta percentage and up/down caret. Secondary small sparkline for tokens/sec.
Error rate micro-gauge: donut microchart showing percentage (0-100%) with color steps: green<=1%, amber<=5%, red>5%.
Cost inline: text showing cost per 1k tokens with small info icon linking to cost breakdown modal. Show currency and unit.
Fallback empty state: single-line placeholder with ‘No data in range’ and action to change time range or open model health view.
data_contract_notes: Primary metric shape: [{timestamp: iso8601, p50: float, p90: float, requests: int, tokens: int, errors: int, cost: float}]
Time-series TTL: design assumes 90 days retained for sparklines; downsampling acceptable after 7 days
Update cadence: UI should poll every 15s in active routes list, and 5s on route detail when live tail enabled
decisions: Use compact metric card across model and route list views to reduce cognitive load compared to full canvas
Prioritize latency P50 as primary metric for card title, with P90 visible in sparkline band
Avoid stacked area for tokens to keep micro-chart readable on narrow widths
Expose detailed charts in a flyout when users click the card — card itself remains read-only
tradeoffs: Compact visuals limit the amount of info — we hide detailed percentiles beyond P90 to keep clarity
Polling cadence tradeoff: faster updates increase cost; chosen default balances freshness vs cost (15s list, 5s detail)
Rendering: prefer SVG for crisp lines but provide Canvas fallback for high datapoint volume
prototype_notes: Prototype includes three breakpoints and hover/click states for desktop. Mobile shows stacked compact rows with a single sparkline and numeric KPIs.
Prototype includes keyboard focus states and ARIA labels for each KPI
Usability script prepared for 6 participants — tasks: find a model with rising latency, compare two routes by cost, open detailed view
review_comments: PM (Marco Ruiz): +1 to compact approach. Request: add callout for active rollouts to show which variant is live in the card.
ENG (Priya Nair): Concern about polling frequency for large orgs. Suggest server-sent events as an optimization for live tail.
SRE (Jonah Lee): Recommend showing SLA breach indicator when P90 > target; align colors with existing alert palette.
Design Lead (Aisha Patel): Minor copy edits and suggested tighter spacing for mobile.
